theorem backend.wbSt_ndel (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : (backend.wbSt P st).ndel =
    st.ndel

def backend.wbSt (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : backend.BSess :=
  { C := st.C, S := st.S, R := backend.writebackR st.W st.R, W := backend.writebackW st.W st.R, pend := st.pend,
    ndel := st.ndel, tx := st.tx,
    cnt := { k := 0, c := 0, p0 := sint.nat st.pend, e := st.cnt.e + P.hookMax * st.cnt.c, hw := false } }

theorem backend.safeSt_writeback {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} (hs : backend.safeSt P
    st) : backend.safeSt P (backend.wbSt P st)

theorem backend.wbSt_R (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : (backend.wbSt P st).R =
    backend.writebackR st.W st.R

theorem backend.vData_writeback_same (P : backend.BParams) (C : backend.Data) (W : backend.WBuf) (R
    : backend.RBuf) (hW : ∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false →
    backend.bkOf W.bks i = []) : backend.vData P (C, backend.writebackR W R) = backend.vData P (C,
    R)

theorem backend.free_of_pend0 {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {n w u : Nat} (hP : P.Wf)
    (hst : backend.sessWf P st) (h : backend.bgOk P st false n w u) (hp : st.pend = W64 0) (hhw :
    st.cnt.hw = false) : backend.freeOk P st ∧ backend.bgOk P st true n w u

theorem backend.vOf_writeback (P : backend.BParams) (C : backend.Data) (W : backend.WBuf) (R :
    backend.RBuf) : backend.vOf P (C, backend.writebackR W R) = backend.ovB P.BT W.bks (backend.vOf
    P (C, R))

theorem backend.wbSt_C (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : (backend.wbSt P st).C = st.C

theorem backend.bgOk_writeback {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {n w u : Nat} (h :
    backend.bgOk P st false n w u) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : backend.bgOk P (backend.wbSt P st) true (n - 1) (w
    + 1) u

theorem backend.rbClean_writeback {P : backend.BParams} {W : backend.WBuf} {R : backend.RBuf} (hW :
    ∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false → backend.bkOf W.bks i = []) (hR
    : backend.rbClean P R) : backend.rbClean P (backend.writebackR W R)

theorem backend.idsOk_writebackW {P : backend.BParams} {W : backend.WBuf} {R : backend.RBuf} (h :
    backend.idsOk P W.bks) : backend.idsOk P (backend.writebackW W R).bks

theorem backend.bgOk_unfree {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {n w u : Nat} (h :
    backend.bgOk P st true n w u) : backend.bgOk P st false n w u

theorem backend.mem_bkOf_wbMerge {W R : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)} {i : w64} {e : backend.Ent} (h
    : e ∈ backend.bkOf (backend.wbMerge W R) i) : e ∈ backend.bkOf R i ∨ e ∈ backend.bkOf W i

theorem backend.wbSt_S (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : (backend.wbSt P st).S = st.S

theorem backend.wbSt_tx (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : (backend.wbSt P st).tx = st.tx

theorem backend.wbSt_pend (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : (backend.wbSt P st).pend =
    st.pend

theorem backend.bkOf_writebackW (W : backend.WBuf) (R : backend.RBuf) (i : w64) : backend.bkOf
    (backend.writebackW W R).bks i = []

theorem backend.mem_canon {l : List backend.Ent} {e : backend.Ent} (h : e ∈ backend.canon l) : e ∈ l

theorem backend.sessWf_writeback {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} (hst : backend.sessWf P
    st) (hpn : st.pend ≠ W64 0) : backend.sessWf P (backend.wbSt P st)

theorem backend.freeOk_writeback {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} (hst : backend.sessWf P
    st) (hpn : st.pend ≠ W64 0) (hl : sint.Z st.pend < sint.Z P.limit) (hd : ¬0 < sint.Z st.ndel) :
    backend.freeOk P (backend.wbSt P st)

theorem backend.wbSt_W (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : (backend.wbSt P st).W =
    backend.writebackW st.W st.R
